headline: BFF explores Brazil national team friendly in Dhaka this October
summary: BFF President Tabith Awal confirms discussions with the Brazilian Football Confederation (CBF) regarding a potential match and infrastructure development.
details: Bangladesh Football Federation (BFF) president Tabith Awal announced that the federation has discussed all possible options with a delegation from the Brazilian Football Confederation (CBF) following their recent visit to Dhaka.
The five-time world champions are scheduled to play friendlies against Australia in September and a match against India in Kolkata on October 3.
Discussions centered on the possibility of Brazil playing a friendly against Bangladesh in Dhaka on October 5 or 6, or potentially holding a training session before their India trip.
The CBF delegation inspected facilities at the National Stadium and Bashundhara Kings Arena, finding the pitches to be of an acceptable standard, though some infrastructure improvements are needed.
Beyond matches, the two federations agreed to collaborate on infrastructure, pitch development, joint coaching programmes, sports science, and future neutral venue possibilities.
However, the match depends on Bangladesh's schedule, as the team is committed to the FIFA ASEAN Cup in Indonesia from September 24 to October 4.
caption:
Could the five-time world champions land in Dhaka? 🇧🇷🇧🇩

Bangladesh Football Federation (BFF) president Tabith Awal announced that the federation has discussed all possible options with a delegation from the Brazilian Football Confederation (CBF) following their recent visit to Dhaka.

The five-time world champions are scheduled to play friendlies against Australia in September and a match against India in Kolkata on October 3.

Discussions centered on the possibility of Brazil playing a friendly against Bangladesh in Dhaka on October 5 or 6, or potentially holding a training session before their India trip.

The CBF delegation inspected facilities at the National Stadium and Bashundhara Kings Arena, finding the pitches to be of an acceptable standard, though some infrastructure improvements are needed.

Beyond matches, the two federations agreed to collaborate on infrastructure, pitch development, joint coaching programmes, sports science, and future neutral venue possibilities.

However, the match depends on Bangladesh's schedule, as the team is committed to the FIFA ASEAN Cup in Indonesia from September 24 to October 4.

Source: Prothom Alo, The Daily Star

headline: March 14: 2027 SSC exams to begin after schedule shift
summary: The Inter-Education Board Coordination Committee has published the routine for the 2027 SSC examinations, moving the start date from January to March.
details: The Secondary School Certificate (SSC) examinations for 2027 under the nine general education boards will begin on March 14 and conclude on April 15.
The Inter-Education Board Coordination Committee released the schedule after receiving approval from the education ministry.
The exams were originally planned to start on January 7, but the date was shifted to accommodate Ramadan, Eid-ul-Fitr, and feedback from guardians.
All theoretical exams will start at 10:00 am, while practical exams must be completed by April 22.
The schedule begins with Bangla First Paper on March 14, followed by Bangla Second Paper on March 16 and English First Paper on March 18.
English Second Paper will be held on March 21, ICT on March 22, Mathematics on March 25, and Bangladesh and Global Studies on March 28.
Group-based and optional subjects will continue through April 15.
caption:
SSC 2027 exams are set to start on March 14. The schedule was shifted from January to avoid clashes with Ramadan and Eid-ul-Fitr.

The Secondary School Certificate (SSC) examinations for 2027 under the nine general education boards will begin on March 14 and conclude on April 15.

The Inter-Education Board Coordination Committee released the schedule after receiving approval from the education ministry.

The exams were originally planned to start on January 7, but the date was shifted to accommodate Ramadan, Eid-ul-Fitr, and feedback from guardians.

All theoretical exams will start at 10:00 am, while practical exams must be completed by April 22.

The schedule begins with Bangla First Paper on March 14, followed by Bangla Second Paper on March 16 and English First Paper on March 18.

English Second Paper will be held on March 21, ICT on March 22, Mathematics on March 25, and Bangladesh and Global Studies on March 28.

Group-based and optional subjects will continue through April 15.

Source: The Daily Star, Jamuna TV, Dhaka Tribune
